jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE tiny pixel-art customer keyframe sheet for the existing potion-shop game, not a scene.
Input image 1 (elf-3x.png) is the APPROVED pixel style and body-proportion reference ONLY. Match its chunky, very simple pixels and head/body/short-leg proportions exactly. Do not use the elf identity, green clothes, pointed ears, or held item.
Input image 2 (traveler_preview_4x.png) is the existing TRAVELER identity/costume and walk-direction reference ONLY. Preserve the short brown hair, light shirt, brown short pants, brown short boots, backpack with a single pale bedroll, friendly adult male traveler, facing LEFT. Simplify to the approved reference's coarse style; no old high-detail shading.
Create exactly EIGHT complete full-body poses of this SAME traveler, in a precise FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW equal-cell sheet. Each logical cell is 32x48 pixels. The body fits inside each cell, with transparent top rows 0..10 because this traveler has NO hat. Head/hair occupies rows 11..26 (16 pixels high, roughly22 pixels wide), torso/clothes rows27..39 (13 high), legs/boots rows40..46 (7 high), row47 transparent. All feet share bottom baseline row46. Match the elf reference's body proportions, not total image height; do NOT enlarge a head to fill upper blank space. Each pose is drawn coherently as a whole body. Same head size/face/clothes/backpack/bedroll in every frame. All faces look left in a readable three-quarter view, with TWO visible equal dark eyes, each1x2 logical pixels at the same height, separated from bangs with a skin gap. No eye merges into hair or outline. No eyebrows.
Exact palette FIVE colors only: deep plum-black #241C32 for continuous one-logical-pixel outline and eyes; warm pale skin #F6D1AC for face/hands/knees; cream ivory #FFF0BC for the plain shirt and rolled blanket; walnut brown #916047 for hair/boots/belt/backpack dark areas; honey brown #C99463 for shorts/backpack light areas. Solid pixel clusters, no gradient, dithering, antialiasing, shine, texture, small embroidery or extra colors. No hat, cape, weapon or extra ornament. Backpack may protrude on screen-right but not enlarge the torso height. Legs remain short; NO long realistic limbs.
Frame order left to right, top row then bottom row:
0 idle: relaxed standing, knees and both feet readable, empty hands.
1 walk_contact_a: near anatomical leg forward toward SCREEN-LEFT, far leg back to SCREEN-RIGHT, opposite arm swing, heel/toe contact, both ground contacts on common baseline.
2 walk_pass_a: near leg supports weight under hips, far knee passes slightly forward with the far foot lifted1-2 pixels; coherent torso/arm counter-swing.
3 walk_contact_b: FAR anatomical leg forward toward SCREEN-LEFT, NEAR leg back to SCREEN-RIGHT, actual opposite thigh/knee/foot geometry and arm swing. Do NOT simply mirror pose1 or swap boot colors.
4 walk_pass_b: FAR leg supports weight under hips, NEAR knee passes forward with its foot lifted1-2 pixels, opposite arm swing to pose2.
5 receive_extend: stand on both feet, near hand extends toward SCREEN-LEFT at chest height to receive a separately rendered bottle, fingers only simple block, open empty hand. Face/head scale unchanged.
6 receive_hold: stand on both feet, near hand held steadily close to chest with empty space above the palm for a SEPARATE bottle; no bottle, coin, magic or particles baked into character.
7 blink_idle: exactly pose0 with eyes closed; same body, backpack, head and feet.
Every frame fully inside its own equal cell with generous transparent separation. TRUE transparent alpha background; no floor, ground shadow, grid lines, labels, text, title, numbers or border. Render as enlarged nearest-neighbor genuine low-res pixels, not high-resolution pixel-like illustration. ONLY this one character's sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: the eight-pose brown traveler sheet. Preserve the exact character, short brown hair, cream shirt, short brown pants, bare knees, brown boots, backpack/pale rolled blanket, five-color simple coarse pixel art, two visible eyes, same head size and common foot baseline. TRUE transparent background and same exact four-column two-row equal-cell arrangement. Image2 is ONLY the approved simple proportion/style reference.
Correct ONLY the walking B poses: top row FOURTH cell (index3 walk_contact_b) and bottom row FIRST cell (index4 walk_pass_b). The current contactB looks like the same leg/arm phase as contactA. Draw the complete B walking figure coherently, maintaining its head/backpack identity, with the OPPOSITE anatomical near/far leg connections and opposite arms.
At index1/contactA the near anatomical leg steps forward toward screen-left and the near arm swings backward toward screen-right.
For index3/contactB: the NEAR anatomical thigh must now descend from the near hip toward screen-right/back, its knee clearly at the right/rear side, rear heel lifted slightly. The FAR anatomical thigh crosses behind that near thigh and extends forward toward screen-left; clearly draw the hip overlap line and front knee/boot belonging to that far thigh. Near shoulder/elbow/hand now swing FORWARD toward screen-left (hand left of chest), far arm swings BACK behind torso toward screen-right. Shift the shorts' split/overlap in the opposite phase. Do NOT mirror the head, hair, face or backpack: backpack stays on screen-right. This is actual full-body opposite joint geometry, not a boot recolor or a copy of contactA. Both poses' forward feet still point toward screen-left.
For index4/passB: far leg is planted directly under pelvis on baseline, NEAR thigh/knee now lifts and passes forward toward screen-left; near arm swings forward, far arm back, opposite index2/passA. Keep short seven-logical-pixel legs, not elongated anatomy. Head occupies same16-logical-pixel zone, torso/clothes13, legs/boots7; every body keeps the same size as other cells.
Cells0 idle,1 contactA,2 passA,5 receive_extend,6 receive_hold and7 blink_idle stay exactly as supplied, preserving same faces. Empty hands, no bottle or particles. No labels, scene, ground, extra colors or smoothing. Single eight-frame sheet on TRUE transparent alpha.
